```sql
SELECT products.product_id, products.product_name, SUM(supplies.supply_cost) AS supply_cost
FROM "jaffle_shop"."dev"."supplies" AS supplies
JOIN "jaffle_shop"."dev"."products" AS products
  ON supplies.product_id = products.product_id
GROUP BY products.product_id, products.product_name
ORDER BY supply_cost DESC
```
